headline: Wall Street trades lower; market absorbs momentum from Nvidia report
summary: US indexes fell after a positive start that followed Nvidia's results. Bank shares declined, and bets on interest rate increases weighed on sentiment.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its results are a key read on AI spending. The S&P 500 tracks the 500 largest US listed companies.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: The market reaction followed Nvidia's own results report.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stocks gave up an early positive move after Nvidia's report, as bank shares fell and investors bet on higher interest rates.
original_headline: Wall Street opera con pérdidas; mercado absorbe impulso del reporte de Nvidia
